signal: Onspring expanded its GRC suite with a new Data Privacy Management product and is investing strategic capital into AI, integrations, and UX

email.body1:
Brianna, saw Onspring add Data Privacy Management to the GRC suite and invest into AI and integrations.

As the platform expands, the real revops bottleneck is rarely the data, it is the latency between a buying signal firing and a touch going out, so in-market accounts cool before a rep reaches them. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Onspring off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Brianna, quick follow-up for Onspring.

Most revops teams can surface intent faster than the team can act on it, so signal-to-touch latency quietly caps conversion no matter how clean the data is. The measurable win is compressing that lag without adding reps to absorb the new product volume.

I put together a teardown of a signals-to-outbound motion, three things I would change to lift response rates 50 to 70 percent. Want to grab 15 minutes and I will walk you through it?
email.body3:
Brianna, last bit of proof for Onspring.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Onspring's reply rate likely compares to other GRC-software vendors. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Brianna, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If compressing signal-to-action latency without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Launching a new product line is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a signals-driven motion? I will tailor it to Onspring either way.
